name: b-create-customers-cur
statement: CREATE TABLE customers_cur (CUSTOMER_ID DECIMAL(10,0), NAME STRING, TIER STRING, CREATED TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3), PRIMARY KEY (CUSTOMER_ID) NOT ENFORCED) WITH ('changelog.mode' = 'upsert');

name: b-create-orders-cur
statement: CREATE TABLE orders_cur (ORDER_ID DECIMAL(10,0), CUSTOMER_ID DECIMAL(10,0), STATUS STRING, ORDER_TS TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3), PRIMARY KEY (ORDER_ID) NOT ENFORCED) WITH ('changelog.mode' = 'upsert');

name: b-create-lines-cur
statement: CREATE TABLE lines_cur (ORDER_ID DECIMAL(10,0), LINE_NO DECIMAL(10,0), SKU STRING, QTY DECIMAL(10,0), PRICE DECIMAL(18,4), PRIMARY KEY (ORDER_ID, LINE_NO) NOT ENFORCED) WITH ('changelog.mode' = 'upsert');

name: b-create-order-doc
statement: CREATE TABLE order_doc (ORDER_ID INT, CUSTOMER_ID INT, STATUS STRING, ORDER_TS TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3), customer ROW<CUSTOMER_ID INT, NAME STRING, TIER STRING, CREATED TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3)>, lines ARRAY<ROW<LINE_NO INT, SKU STRING, QTY INT, PRICE DECIMAL(18, 4)>>, PRIMARY KEY (ORDER_ID) NOT ENFORCED) WITH ('changelog.mode' = 'upsert', 'key.format' = 'avro-registry', 'value.format' = 'avro-registry', 'value.fields-include' = 'all');

name: b-ins-customers-cur
statement: INSERT INTO customers_cur SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, NAME, TIER, CREATED FROM FROM_CHANGELOG(input => TABLE `bench.BENCH_CUSTOMERS` PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID, op => DESCRIPTOR(op_type), op_mapping => MAP['R, I','INSERT', 'U','UPDATE_AFTER', 'D','DELETE']);

name: b-ins-orders-cur
statement: INSERT INTO orders_cur SELECT ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS, ORDER_TS FROM FROM_CHANGELOG(input => TABLE `bench.BENCH_ORDERS` PARTITION BY ORDER_ID, op => DESCRIPTOR(op_type), op_mapping => MAP['R, I','INSERT', 'U','UPDATE_AFTER', 'D','DELETE']);

name: b-ins-lines-cur
statement: INSERT INTO lines_cur SELECT ORDER_ID, LINE_NO, SKU, QTY, PRICE FROM FROM_CHANGELOG(input => TABLE `bench.BENCH_LINES` PARTITION BY (ORDER_ID, LINE_NO), op => DESCRIPTOR(op_type), op_mapping => MAP['R, I','INSERT', 'U','UPDATE_AFTER', 'D','DELETE']);

name: b-ins-order-doc
statement: INSERT INTO order_doc SELECT CAST(o.ORDER_ID AS INT), CAST(o.CUSTOMER_ID AS INT), o.STATUS, o.ORDER_TS, CASE WHEN c.CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS ROW<CUSTOMER_ID INT, NAME STRING, TIER STRING, CREATED TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3)>) ELSE ROW(CAST(c.CUSTOMER_ID AS INT), c.NAME, c.TIER, c.CREATED) END, l.lines FROM orders_cur o LEFT JOIN customers_cur c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORDER_ID, ARRAY_AGG(ROW(CAST(LINE_NO AS INT), SKU, CAST(QTY AS INT), PRICE)) AS lines FROM lines_cur GROUP BY ORDER_ID) l ON l.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID;
